text: FAA guidance (AC 107-2A) requires reestablishing the control link or initiating emergency procedures when a loss of control link occurs. It also instructs describing actions for the hazard and to discontinue flight until inspection and testing of the control link. In the Matrice 30T manual, the actions on signal loss include RTH, land, or hover, with Advanced RTH used for RTH and Original Route RTH if lighting or vision systems are unavailable. There is no usable evidence from incident reports in the collection for DJI Matrice 30T losses; main gaps remain about how RTH interacts with obstacle avoidance and obstacle clearance, and whether RTH altitude accounts for fixed hazards like power lines.
